error.E_DB_NOT_CONFIGURED: This database has no section in the config file, so it runs in offline mode. Only inspection and DDL are available.
error.E_DB_PASSWORD_MISSING: No password found. Set environment variable {env} or put password in parqbridge.local.toml.
error.E_UPLOAD_TOO_LARGE: The upload exceeds the configured size limit of {max_bytes} bytes.
error.E_PARQUET_INVALID: The file is not a valid Parquet file.
error.E_PATH_NOT_ALLOWED: Only paths inside an allowed folder can be selected.
error.E_FILE_NOT_FOUND: The selected file handle was not found.
error.E_TABLE_NAME_INVALID: Invalid table name for {dialect}; expected up to {max_length} characters/bytes using letters, digits, and underscores.
error.E_EXPLODE_COLUMN_INVALID: Explode column {column} is not a list column in this file.
error.E_PARENT_KEY_INVALID: Parent key {column} must name a top-level scalar column.
error.E_CONFIRM_REQUIRED: Retype the exact parent table name {table} to confirm this operation.
error.E_DDL_OUTPUT_PROTECTED: The input or a Parquet file cannot be used as DDL output: {path}.
error.E_DDL_OUTPUT_EXISTS: Output file already exists: {path}. Use --force to replace it.
error.E_APPEND_COLUMNS_MISMATCH: Existing columns do not match the load plan for {table}. Missing: {missing}; extra: {extra}.
error.E_DB_CONNECT: Could not connect to the database (driver code: {driver_code}).
error.E_LOAD_FAILED: Load failed for {table}, batch {batch_index}, row {row_index} in {row_index_scope} scope; {committed_batches} batches and {committed_rows} rows remain committed (driver code: {driver_code}).
error.E_JOB_NOT_FOUND: The load job was not found.
error.E_JOB_CONFLICT: Another load job is already active for {table} or one of its child tables.
error.E_STRING_SCAN_CANCELLED: The string-length scan was cancelled or the file selection was released.
error.E_LOCAL_INFILE_UNAVAILABLE: LOAD DATA LOCAL INFILE is unavailable; use batch INSERTs.
error.E_POSTGRES_NUL_CHARACTER: PostgreSQL cannot store NUL characters in text or JSON values. Check {table}.{column}, batch {batch_index}, row {row_index} in {row_index_scope} scope. {committed_batches} batches and {committed_rows} rows remain committed.
error.E_ROUTE_NOT_FOUND: The requested API route was not found.
error.E_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED: This HTTP method is not supported by the API route.
error.E_HTTP_ERROR: The HTTP request could not be handled.
warning.W_BIND_ALL_INTERFACES: The server binds to all interfaces ({host}). This is a local tool; 127.0.0.1 is recommended.
warning.W_PASSWORD_IN_MAIN_CONFIG: Ignored password in [db.{kind}] of {file}. Use an environment variable or parqbridge.local.toml.
warning.W_ALLOWED_ROOT_MISSING: Allowed root {root} does not exist or is not a folder; it was skipped.
warning.W_DECIMAL_PRECISION_WIDE: Decimal precision {precision} exceeds the {dialect} limit and is stored as text.
warning.W_TIMESTAMP_TZ_UTC: Timezone timestamp values from {source_timezone} are converted to UTC for MySQL DATETIME.
warning.W_TIMESTAMP_PRECISION_LOSS: Timestamp precision {precision} is reduced to {target_precision} for {dialect}.
warning.W_TIME_PRECISION_LOSS: Time precision {precision} is reduced to {target_precision} for {dialect}.
warning.W_UNSUPPORTED_TYPE: Arrow type {arrow_type} has no direct {dialect} mapping and is stored as text.
warning.W_RESERVED_IDENTIFIER: Identifier {original} conflicts with a {dialect} reserved word and was renamed to {name}.
warning.W_PARENT_KEY_DUPLICATE: Sampled values in parent key {column} are not unique; child foreign keys will not be declared.
warning.W_EXPLODE_ROW_MULTIPLIER: Exploding {column} is expected to produce {expected_rows} rows, about {multiplier} times the source size.
warning.W_STRING_LENGTH_SAMPLED: String lengths were estimated from {sampled_rows} of {total_rows} rows with a {margin}x margin. Longer values may fall outside the sample; use the full-file scan for exact lengths.
warning.W_STRING_LENGTH_ESTIMATED: A sample-based DDL is shown while the full scan is still running. The DDL will update when exact lengths are ready.
warning.W_MYSQL_ROW_SIZE_DEMOTED: The estimated row size for MySQL table {table} ({estimated_bytes} bytes) exceeds the {budget_bytes}-byte budget, so these columns were demoted to TEXT/BLOB: {columns}.
warning.W_IDENTIFIER_COLLISION: {dialect} identifier {original} collided with another name and was renamed to {name}.
warning.W_RESERVED_WORDS_UNAVAILABLE: Oracle reserved words could not be read from V$RESERVED_WORDS; the built-in list is used.
